scope: Current-context emotional behavior, bounded late interpretation refresh, evidence-first own-action repair and aligned persona

independent_review.runtime_scope: epoch, owner, source provenance, reset, restart, delivery, pool concurrency and provider boundaries
independent_review.behavior_scope: current-situation priority, mixtures, expression reserve, cautious repair and persona alignment
findings_fixed: reuse the current SQL connection to avoid a full-pool deadlock
route direct-call intent before freezing the expression plan
validate materials before any optional intent provider and again after routing
do not inherit/freeze emotional plans for auxiliary custom-prompt generations
preserve resolved regulation and latest source reappraisal when refreshing an older prepared turn

validation_environment.database: disposable PostgreSQL 17, isolated per SQL case
validation_environment.network: offline test audit hook permits only loopback

limitations: If interpretation is not ready at prompt assembly, the reply stays on its prepared neutral plan; no extra interpretation calls or post-generation restyling.
Repeated positive affect is limited at expression only. Latent numerical saturation and true habituation are only partially addressed and need a versioned model/rebuild migration.
Mixture/reserve/humor thresholds are engineering assumptions, not calibrated psychological measurements.
Synthetic interpretations and mocked generated responses prove deterministic contracts and data paths, not naturalness or live-model empathy/intent accuracy.
Reported reviews and resolutions remain reports; no inferred blame, success from silence, or automatic strategy learning.
Conservative emotional state provenance can cancel a pending response when an older supporting source is erased.
No live user conversations, production API, Telegram delivery, deployment or end-to-end live LLM behavior evaluation.
